provenance: Generated outside the product with Transformers 5.22.2, PyTorch 2.15.0 CPU, and NumPy 2.5.4 in float32. The tiny text weights are the committed tiny_text fixture; the audio tower is deterministic random initialization with finite clipping bounds. The input is a 0.125 s 440 Hz sine that produces 12 mel frames and three audio soft tokens.
